reasoning: Recent Georgia Senate polling in the last 45 days shows Democrat Jon Ossoff ahead of Republican Mike Collins by margins ranging from +4 to +13, with the most recent high-quality polls clustering around a Democratic lead. No Georgia presidential general-election poll from the provided results is within the last 45 days, so the current race margin is best characterized from Senate polling alone.

sources.name: AARP Poll: Ossoff Leads in Georgia Senate Race — Except Among Older Voters
sources.details: AARP's statewide likely-voter poll found Jon Ossoff leading Mike Collins 52% to 43% in Georgia's Senate race.

sources.name: The Hill
sources.details: The Hill reported the AARP/Fabrizio Ward/Impact Research poll showing Ossoff ahead of Collins by 9 points among likely voters.

sources.name: Inside Elections Senate Report Shorts (citing Fox News poll)
sources.details: Fox News polling, as summarized by Inside Elections, found Ossoff leading Collins 56% to 43% in Georgia's Senate race.

sources.name: The Atlanta Journal-Constitution
sources.details: The Atlanta Journal-Constitution summarized that the Fox News poll showed Ossoff with a solid lead after Collins secured the GOP nomination and noted another poll had the race within the margin of error.
